sourceChecks.text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アロンの子らの名簿に、ナダブ、アビフ、エルアザル、イタマルが挙げられます。

sourceChecks.text: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アロンの子らの名簿に、ナダブ、アビフ、エルアザル、イタマルが挙げられます。

sourceChecks.text: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アロンの子らの名簿に、ナダブ、アビフ、エルアザル、イタマルが挙げられます。
